Summary: The HotpotQA Hits@10 test BM25 retrieval fullwiki performance is reported as 55.88 in the test setting and 56.06 in the dev setting. The full wiki setting requires retrieval from over 5 million Wikipedia paragraphs, which poses a significant challenge to existing techniques in retrieval-based question answering. The model's performance in all settings is significantly lower than human performance, indicating the need for more technical advancements in future work.
